notes.title: Version 1.15 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Dwellers!

We hope you have been enjoying Kabaret! Version 1.15 is now available with some fixes and changes as follows:

[h1][u][b]Tea Ceremony[/b][/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added SFX to Tea Ceremony results when it is correct or wrong
[*] Changed the color of some liquid ingredients in Tea Ceremony to make them more distinct from one another
[/list]


[h1][u][b]Game Performance[/b][/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed unresponsive clicking on touch-screen devices. You no longer have to disable touch-screen to play the game
[*] Fixed fog effect in Main Hall which was causing FPS drop and lagging
[/list]

If you are experiencing any issues or bugs, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JrK9yBP]Discord[/url] and drop us a message! 

With love,
PTG Team

notes.title: Kabaret Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, we are happy to share the new and updated demo! This demo will give you an even closer look at the game as we move closer to launch, with a new minigame added and a more polished look compared to the previous version. 

Please send us any feedback you have via our [url=https://linktr.ee/PersonaTheoryGames ]social channels[/url], or talk directly to us in our community [url=https://discord.gg/79zjrJ8erN]Discord[/url]. We can't wait to share Kabaret in its entirety, and we look forward to hearing from you!
Love,
[url=https://personatheory.com/games/]Persona Theory Games[/url]

What's New:
- New minigame: Performance
- New look: Tea Ceremony has been revamped
- Polished graphics for Congkak
- Polished graphics for Guli
